candidates.title: Draft status updates from changing order data

demandEvidence.chore: Draft customer-facing order status updates when internal operational data is incomplete or changes frequently.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: I’d be interested to hear how others handle customer-facing status updates when internal operational data is incomplete or changes frequently.

ease.reason: A beginner could draft from synthetic order fields, but the post gives no field rules or implementation support.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: small online shops may pay for clearer updates; this discussion establishes no buyer or payment.

feasibility.reason: A four-week mock can draft from sample order states, but handling incomplete or changing data remains untested.

autonomy.reason: A proposed draft loop is possible, but no source supports integrations and a person must verify each status before sending.

evidence.reason: The post directly asks about customer-facing updates amid incomplete or changing data, but gives no frequency or detailed rules.

candidates.reason: Assessed a sample-data drafting experiment; provisional mean is below threshold. It also duplicates recent post 98b4f6281cc3de4ecdfa95f6 on the specific ecommerce customer and customer-communication workflow.

candidates.title: Prepare a restaurant order arrival alert

demandEvidence.chore: Build a system that notifies a restaurant when a new website order arrives.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: I want to build an automated restaurant order notification system using Make.com .

ease.reason: A beginner can format a synthetic order into an alert, but no supplied reference supports a website trigger or delivery.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: a small restaurant may pay for timely order alerts; this request proves neither buyer intent nor payment.

feasibility.reason: A four-week mock can format operator-supplied sample orders; live website access and delivery are unverified.

autonomy.reason: A bounded alert loop is proposed, but its trigger and delivery are unsupported and a person must verify each alert.

evidence.reason: The request identifies order notification, but supplies no frequency, data fields, trigger access, delivery details, or implementation evidence.

candidates.reason: Assessed a synthetic-order alert experiment; provisional mean is below threshold because live triggering and delivery lack implementation evidence, consistent with recent assessments of this same identity.
